transport: real HTTP JSON + Firebase Auth emulator + isolated PostgreSQL via local Neon adapter

checks.title: Settings refuse a missing baseline without mutation or audit
Two manager forms: stale save conflicts and preserves the winner
Every settings column participates in the stale baseline comparison
Simultaneous manager writes create one winner and one audit
Unrelated session and permission updates do not invalidate settings
Settings baseline never grants scoped or cross-workspace authority
Strict baseline forbids omitted columns or forged authority
Administrative DTO remains free of answers and individual learning evidence
Upload and enrollment bounds remain enforced
Scheduled activity has an explicit page without questions or an attempt
Open override permits a stable draft without hidden grading data
Competing draft saves use revisions and never overwrite the winner
Closed session draft is readable with a read-only DTO and rejects saves
Revocation while save waits for a lock denies the write without losing prior data
Same-key double submit creates one immutable result and one audit
Closed course preserves submitted feedback and blocks new attempts
Hidden program denies access and writes while preserving its saved records
Foreign users and cohorts cannot read or submit another learner attempt
Final feedback cannot start a retake while the session is closed
Reopened retake keeps original history and becomes the overview target
Read-only trainer access excludes drafts, private answer banks and other cohorts
Small aggregates remain suppressed and never include individual answers
Learning operations preserve a dedicated nonempty anonymous survey fixture and private pack
Submitted learning idea has an own portfolio receipt with its pending status
Receipt query cannot expose another author, tenant, source or unknown proposal

limits: Local PostgreSQL through the test-only Neon adapter; not a remote Neon transport test.
HTTP assertions do not prove native browser confirmation dialogs, dirty navigation, layout or downloads.
All HTTP fixtures are retained in the disposable local dataset for diagnosis; no real customer data is used.
